form.name: Price Plan Name
form.schedule_locked_tooltip: This price plan is bound to {{.ClientName}}'s price schedule.
form.schedule_auto_create_hint: No price schedule exists for {{.ClientName}} yet — one will be created automatically when you save.
form.schedule_auto_reuse_hint: This price plan will be added to the existing price schedule for {{.ClientName}}.
form.schedule_client_picker_notice: Only plans assigned to this client are available below.
form.schedule_general_picker_notice: Plans assigned specifically to clients are not available for assignment to general-scope price schedules.
form.parent_schedule_client_notice: This price schedule belongs to {{.ClientName}}. Price plans created here will be available only for engagements with this client.
form.billing_kind_one_time_hint: Charged once at signup. No further invoices fire on this subscription.
form.billing_kind_recurring_hint: Billed every cycle. Auto-renews until the operator cancels the subscription.
form.billing_kind_contract_hint: Fixed-term commitment with a defined end date. Can bill periodically within the term or as a single total at signup.
form.billing_kind_milestone_hint: Invoice fires per milestone (engagement phase) as work completes. Requires a JobTemplate on the parent Plan.
form.billing_kind_ad_hoc_hint: Operator-requested usage occurrences (visits, appointments, support calls). Choose Total Package for a prepaid pool or Per Occurrence for pay-per-call.
form.amount_basis_per_cycle_hint: Amount charged each billing cycle. Required for Recurring and Contract-with-cycle plans.
form.amount_basis_total_package_hint: Single total amount charged across the full term. One invoice covers everything; no per-cycle billing.
form.amount_basis_derived_from_lines_hint: Total computed automatically from the per-item ProductPricePlan rows. Amount input is hidden when this is selected.
form.amount_basis_per_occurrence_hint: Amount charged per delivered usage. Pay-as-you-go only — each occurrence fires its own invoice.
form.entitled_occurrences_info: Number of usage occurrences (visits, appointments, support calls) included in the prepaid pool. Required when amount basis is Total Package on a Pay-as-you-go plan.
form.term_open_ended_help: Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration
form.plan_info: The plan this price plan belongs to. Locked from the parent page.
form.schedule_info: The price schedule (date range + location) this price plan belongs to.
form.name_info: Optional — defaults to the plan name when left blank.
form.description_info: Optional notes shown alongside the price plan in detail views.
form.billing_kind_info: One-time = charged once. Recurring = billed every cycle. Fixed-term = recurring with an end date. Milestone = invoice fires per phase. Pay-as-you-go = operator-requested usage occurrences (pool or per-occurrence).
form.amount_basis_info: Per cycle = amount charged each billing cycle. Total package = amount charged across the full term. Sum of items = derived from the per-item breakdown. Per occurrence = amount charged per delivered usage (Pay-as-you-go only).
form.amount_info: Price in the selected currency. For Sum of items, this is computed automatically.
form.currency_info: Currency applied to this price plan and any auto-seeded product price plans.
form.billing_cycle_info: How often the recurring charge is issued (e.g. every 1 month).
form.term_info: How long the engagement lasts. Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration.
form.active_info: Inactive price plans stay on record but are hidden from new subscriptions.

total_package.customer: Pays {{.Amount}} once at signup. No further charges.
total_package.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime Job with phases (if Plan has a JobTemplate).
total_package.revenue: One Revenue at Subscription.Create covering the full amount.

per_cycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}}. Subscription auto-renews until cancelled.
per_cycle.operations: Each cycle spawns {{.VisitsPerCycle}} cycle Job(s) (if Plan has a JobTemplate). Operations tab shows cycle accordions.
per_cycle.revenue: One Revenue per cycle. Recognize Revenue creates the invoice and (via piggyback) spawns the cycle Job if missing.

derived_from_lines.customer: Charged the sum of itemised lines every {{.CycleLabel}}.
derived_from_lines.operations: Each cycle spawns 1+ cycle Jobs. Operations tracking flows through Plan's JobTemplate.
derived_from_lines.revenue: Revenue total computed from ProductPricePlan rows; one Revenue per cycle.

per_cycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}} for {{.TermLength}}. Auto-deactivates at term end.
per_cycle.operations: Same as recurring + the engagement closes when the {{.TermLength}} term completes.
per_cycle.revenue: Same as recurring. Operator can extend the term to spawn additional cycles.

total_package.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime Job (or cycle Jobs if cyclic — see Plan's visits_per_cycle).
total_package.revenue: One Revenue at signup; cycle Jobs are operational only.

total_package.customer: Pays {{.Amount}} total. Invoice fires per milestone (engagement phase) as work completes.
total_package.operations: Lifetime engagement Job with phases. BillingEvent rows gate per-milestone invoicing.
total_package.revenue: Revenue per milestone trigger; sum across milestones equals the total package.

total_package.customer: Pays {{.Amount}} upfront for {{.EntitledOccurrences}} usage occurrences (e.g. service visits, appointments, support calls).
total_package.operations: Operator requests each usage from the Operations tab. Pool exhausts after {{.EntitledOccurrences}} usages — operator can extend.
total_package.revenue: One Revenue at signup covering the whole pool; subsequent usages are operationally tracked only.

per_occurrence.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} per usage occurrence. No upfront cost.
per_occurrence.operations: Operator requests each usage from the Operations tab. Each completed usage flips its BillingEvent to READY for invoicing.
per_occurrence.revenue: One Revenue per delivered usage. Recognize Revenue per usage row.

warning.milestone_no_template: Milestone billing requires the Plan to have a JobTemplate. Configure it on the Plan first.
warning.recurring_no_template: This subscription will not have operational tracking. Add a JobTemplate to the Plan to enable cycle Jobs.
warning.visits_per_cycle_invalid_kind: visits_per_cycle is only valid for cyclic plans. Reset to 1 or change the billing kind.
warning.ad_hoc_pool_no_template: AD_HOC pool plans require the Plan to have a JobTemplate so usages can be tracked. Configure it on the Plan first.
warning.ad_hoc_per_call_no_template: AD_HOC pay-per-call plans require the Plan to have a JobTemplate so usages can be tracked. Configure it on the Plan first.
warning.ad_hoc_no_entitlement: AD_HOC pool plans need entitled occurrences > 0. Set the value or switch to per-occurrence billing.
warning.ad_hoc_billing_cycle_not_allowed: AD_HOC plans are event-driven, not calendar-driven. Remove the billing cycle or change the billing kind.
warning.ad_hoc_visits_per_cycle_not_allowed: AD_HOC plans cannot use multi-visit cycles. Reset visits_per_cycle to 1 or change the billing kind.
